Plausible synthetic values for a named covariate

Source: R/mock.R
mock_covariate_values.Rd

Values sit in each covariate's real range and units so mock output is not misleading to look at. SST and CHL additionally carry the same latitudinal and seasonal structure planted in the mock abundances, giving the model real signal to recover; the rest are weakly structured noise.

Usage

mock_covariate_values(name, lat_effect, season_effect, n)

Arguments

name

covariate name from copernicus_covariates()

lat_effect

scaled latitude, 0 at the south edge and 1 at the north

season_effect

seasonal cycle term, ranging from -1 to 1

n

number of grid points

Value

numeric vector of length n
